mutation: set each current optimizer parameter-group learning rate to zero for 1600 optimizer steps, then restore its prefix-native value
stability_effect_rationale: The hold freezes rule-bearing parameters and therefore rule-probability progress, while gradients and Adam moments continue to update. After learning-rate restoration the same rule-margin/slingshot law resumes from a re-equilibrated optimizer reservoir; capability formation is delayed, but the recurrent post-formation slingshot class is not removed.

mechanism_state_change.rule_probability: held at its intervention-start value while learning rate is zero
mechanism_state_change.rule_probability_velocity_per_grid: zero during the hold and restored afterward
mechanism_state_change.optimizer_reservoir: continues adapting because gradient and Adam moment formation are not frozen
mechanism_state_change.predicted_transition_step: shifted later by 1300 to 1900 optimizer steps
